global_rules.availability_not_selection: Existing cache/legacy availability may be considered only after this manifest; it did not define the frozen frontier.
global_rules.broker_mapping: Each canonical instrument must be mapped one-to-one to an ENABLED Pepperstone cTrader symbol and hash-bound before its first economic outcome; inability to map blocks that candidate without creating an economic failure.
global_rules.causal_availability: Only completed bars/events and metadata effective at or before decision timestamp may be visible.
global_rules.completed_bar_semantics: A bar becomes available at its close timestamp; next-event entry must be strictly later unless the candidate explicitly defines a prospectively known scheduled close exit.
global_rules.currency_conversion: Where quote/account conversion is material, acquire a causal conversion series or broker-native conversion evidence effective at each required cashflow timestamp.
global_rules.missing_data: Do not synthesize missing bars or silently forward-fill prices.
global_rules.timestamps: bar/event availability timestamps must be unambiguous UTC; source timezone retained as metadata when needed for session mapping
